# shard writer (on each node)
def inc(shard, key):

    self.wal.append((shard, key))

examples.query: Summarize this API design doc for execs. One paragraph, focus on cost and customer impact, no technical terms.
examples.context: Proposal: Consolidate notification delivery. Today, email, SMS, and push notifications are sent by three separate services owned by three teams. Each has its own retry logic, template system, and rate limiting. This causes duplicate notifications (~2% of users get the same alert twice), inconsistent branding, and slow feature work: adding a new notification type takes ~3 weeks across teams. We propose a single notification platform with a shared template store, unified preference center, and per-channel adapters. Estimated effort: 2 quarters, 4 engineers. Risks: migration of 140 existing templates; SMS vendor contract renegotiation.
